import { mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import {
  type DataTable,
  type DocNode,
  type GraphNode,
  type Layer,
  newUserPreset,
  parseProject,
  type Project,
  presetRecipe,
  writePreset,
} from '@ps/model'
import { expect, it } from 'vitest'
import { layoutGraph, presetGraph, sceneToSvg } from '../src/index.ts'
import { addLayers, graphOf, withLayer } from './graphs.ts'
import { fixedTable, fonts, projectOf, sampleVariables } from './helpers.ts'

// Roadmap 49c: v2 fixtures of clustered heat maps, written by the 0.3.4 code (commit dbc7ece,
// schema v2: the trees in the tile layer's `style.cluster`), with their SVGs as 0.3.4 drew them.
// Run on that commit's tree: V2_OUT=<dir> vitest run packages/graph/test/genV2Fixtures.test.ts

const OUT = process.env.V2_OUT

const one = { type: 'replicates', count: 1 } as const

/** A grouped table of rows × data sets (one value per cell), named rows and data sets. */
function grouped(rows: readonly (readonly number[])[]): DataTable {
  const cols = rows[0]!.map((_, j) => [rows.map((r) => r[j]!)])
  return fixedTable('grouped', one, cols, {
    titles: cols.map((_, j) => `Sample ${j + 1}`),
    rowTitles: rows.map((_, i) => `Gene ${i + 1}`),
  })
}

const GROUPED = grouped([
  [1, 9, 2, 8, 4],
  [2, 7, 1, 9, 3],
  [0, 8, 3, 7, 5],
  [5, 5, 6, 4, 2],
  [9, 1, 8, 2, 6],
  [3, 6, 2, 5, 9],
  [8, 2, 9, 1, 7],
])

const MV = (() => {
  const cols = [
    [[4.1, 3.2, 5.5, 6.0, 2.2, 4.8, 3.9, 5.1]],
    [[1.0, 2.1, 0.5, 0.9, 2.8, 1.4, 2.0, 0.7]],
    [[7.5, 6.1, 8.2, 8.9, 5.0, 7.1, 6.4, 8.0]],
    [[0.2, 0.9, 0.1, 0.3, 1.2, 0.6, 0.8, 0.2]],
  ]
  const t = fixedTable('multipleVariables', one, cols, {
    titles: ['Height', 'Weight', 'Span', 'Mass'],
    rowTitles: ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E', 'F', 'G', 'H'],
  })
  return t
})()

const CONTINGENCY = fixedTable(
  'contingency',
  one,
  [[[12, 30, 7, 22]], [[15, 28, 9, 20]], [[40, 5, 33, 8]]],
  { titles: ['Low', 'Mid', 'High'], rowTitles: ['North', 'South', 'East', 'West'] },
)

const cells = (g: GraphNode, style: Record<string, unknown>, more: Partial<Layer> = {}) =>
  withLayer(g, 'cells', { ...more, style } as never)

/** The fixture graphs: name, table, graph. */
function cases(): [string, DataTable, GraphNode][] {
  const heat = (t: DataTable) => graphOf(t, 'heatmap')
  const dots = (() => {
    const t = sampleVariables()
    const g = { ...presetGraph(t, 'dotPlot'), id: 'g1' as never }
    return addLayers(
      g,
      [
        {
          id: 'tiles',
          geom: 'tile',
          stat: { kind: 'dotplot' },
          aes: { group: 'a' },
          style: { cluster: { rows: true, dendrogram: 30 } },
        } as Layer,
      ],
      0,
    )
  })()
  return [
    ['heatmap-both-by-layer', GROUPED, cells(heat(GROUPED), { cluster: { rows: true, columns: true } })],
    [
      'heatmap-rows-depth-values',
      GROUPED,
      addLayers(
        cells(heat(GROUPED), {
          cluster: { rows: true, distance: 'pearson', linkage: 'ward', dendrogram: 50 },
        }),
        [{ id: 'values', geom: 'label', stat: { kind: 'cell' }, on: 'cells' } as Layer],
      ),
    ],
    [
      'heatmap-columns-by-data-set',
      GROUPED,
      {
        ...cells(
          heat(GROUPED),
          { cluster: { columns: true, linkage: 'average', dendrogram: 24 } },
          { stat: { kind: 'cell', standardize: 'row' } } as Partial<Layer>,
        ),
        drawOrder: 'series',
        scales: { color: { colors: 'blueRed' } },
      },
    ],
    [
      'heatmap-hidden-tile',
      GROUPED,
      cells(heat(GROUPED), { cluster: { rows: true, dendrogram: 40 } }, { visible: false }),
    ],
    [
      'heatmap-two-tiles',
      GROUPED,
      addLayers(
        cells(
          heat(GROUPED),
          { cluster: { rows: true, columns: true, dendrogram: 20 } },
          { visible: false },
        ),
        [{ id: 'cells2', geom: 'tile', stat: { kind: 'cell' } } as Layer],
      ),
    ],
    ['dotplot-tile-cluster', sampleVariables(), dots],
    [
      'mv-heatmap-bottom-scale',
      MV,
      {
        ...cells(heat(MV), { cluster: { rows: true, dendrogram: 20 } }),
        scales: { color: { bar: { position: 'bottom' } } },
      },
    ],
    [
      'contingency-heatmap-both',
      CONTINGENCY,
      cells(heat(CONTINGENCY), {
        cluster: { rows: true, columns: true, distance: 'pearson', linkage: 'average' },
      }),
    ],
  ]
}

const fixed = (project: Project): Project => ({
  ...project,
  meta: {
    ...project.meta,
    created: '2026-10-11T00:00:00.000Z',
    modified: '2026-10-11T00:00:00.000Z',
  },
})

it.runIf(!!OUT)('writes the v2 fixtures and their 0.3.4 renders', () => {
  const dir = OUT!
  mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true })
  const names: string[] = []
  for (const [name, table, graph] of cases()) {
    const project = fixed(projectOf(table, graph as DocNode))
    const opened = parseProject(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(project)))
    expect(opened.schemaVersion).toBe(2)
    const g = opened.nodes[graph.id] as GraphNode
    const svg = sceneToSvg(layoutGraph({ project: opened, graph: g, fonts }), { ids: true })
    writeFileSync(join(dir, `${name}.json`), `${JSON.stringify(project, null, 1)}\n`)
    writeFileSync(join(dir, `${name}.svg`), svg)
    names.push(name)
  }
  writeFileSync(join(dir, 'index.json'), `${JSON.stringify(names, null, 1)}\n`)
  // A user preset (file version 1) of a clustered heat map with its values.
  const g = cases()[1]![2]
  const preset = {
    ...newUserPreset('Clustered heat map', presetRecipe(g, 'grouped')),
    created: '2026-10-11T00:00:00.000Z',
  }
  writeFileSync(join(dir, 'clustered-heatmap.pspreset'), writePreset(preset, { exported: true }))
})
